name: Aqara Hub M3 (EU)

radios.note: Aqara's launch release lists Thread, Zigbee, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and IR, with dual-band Wi-Fi and a PoE Ethernet port. Model number HM-G01D comes from retailers only.

matter.note: The M3's own CSA listing is a Zigbee 3.0 certificate. CSA's Aqara Hub Platform software certificate covers Aqara hubs, but no result confirmed it names the M3.

apple_home.note: Through the hub's Matter bridge; Aqara names this ecosystem for its Advanced Matter Bridging. Not every Aqara Zigbee device is bridged.

google_home.note: Through the hub's Matter bridge; Aqara names this ecosystem for its Advanced Matter Bridging. Not every Aqara Zigbee device is bridged.

alexa.note: Through the hub's Matter bridge; Aqara names this ecosystem for its Advanced Matter Bridging. Not every Aqara Zigbee device is bridged.

smartthings.note: Through the hub's Matter bridge; Aqara names this ecosystem for its Advanced Matter Bridging. Not every Aqara Zigbee device is bridged.

home_assistant.note: Through the Matter bridge; Aqara is a Works with Home Assistant partner for its Matter products. Not every Aqara Zigbee device is bridged.

hubRequired.note: It is the hub; Aqara's FAQ says it can lead other Aqara Zigbee hubs.

localControl.note: Aqara says automations run locally on the hub. Push notifications, weather and geofencing still need the cloud.

deviceProtocols.note: Built-in IR blaster; CSA describes Zigbee 3.0 and Bluetooth child devices.

matterBridge.note: Aqara says Advanced Matter Bridging started on the Hub M3. Some Aqara Zigbee devices have no Matter device type and are not bridged.

threadBorderRouter.note: Aqara's FAQ and CSA listing both say the hub is a Thread Border Router.

maxDevices.note: No figure confirmed on an official page; retailers quote 127 or 128 devices.

summary: Placeholder summary pending the editor: this record lists what the hub connects to and which ecosystems see those devices. Aqara Zigbee, Thread and Matter hub with an IR blaster, EU version.
